Name: Strawberry my Jodi
Author: Aridozi
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod changes Jodi's look when using Seasonal Outfits OR all 3 of these mods:[/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] (by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url])[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7721]Datable Jodi[/url] (by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48537948]Moralle[/url]) [/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]The compatibility mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27384]Datable Jodi Seasonal Portraits[/url] (by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/201099611]COMEDYalberto[/url])[/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#d4d4d8]You do NOT need to have installed the Datable Jodi mods to use this as Datable Jodi only uses her blush portraits which are originally unnecessary and unused. Datable Jodi and Datable Jodi Seasonal Portraits uses those portraits, which are portraits and sprits that I have changed.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Drag and drop the folder into your Mods Directory (\Stardew Valley\Mods) with [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters installed.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Please ensure that you replace the files it asks, otherwise the new portraits and sprites won't replace the old ones.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][b]This is not a new mod folder[/b], it only replaces the images found in both Jodi folders in the Seasonal Cute Characters mod folder.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url][/color][/*]
[/list]Optional but recommended:
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7721]Datable Jodi[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27384]Datable Jodi Seasonal Portraits[/url][/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]All credit should be given to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] for the cute ouftits, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48537948]Moralle[/url] for making Jodi (my one and only romance ever) romanceable, and  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/201099611]COMEDYalberto[/url] for allowing my beloved Jodi to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url]'s seasonal closet. Without them, I don't know how I'd be able to play this game. I love my wife. I want to be able to romance her, have her be fashionable, and finally (thanks to me) now she can have that strawberry hair that I fell in love with in the first place.[/color]
